variants.name: Berries 85 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Highly varied berry mix
  • A delicious natural mixture including grapes, rosehips, juniper berries, rowan berries and cranberries
  • Very tasty composition for good intake and smooth digestion
  • Ideal snack for rabbits and herbivorous and omnivorous rodents
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: kibbled carob, timothy hay, juniper berry (7%), rowan berries (7%), cranberries, rosehip (5.7%), safflower seed, soya hulls, raisins, sunflower seed meal, potato flour, pine nuts, beetroot flakes, sunflower seed, broken peas, horse bean flakes, parsnip, soya meal, pumpkin and squash seed, tomato flakes, linseed, toasted soya beans, alfalfa, dried beet pulp, monocalcium phosphate, calcium magnesium carbonate, sodium chloride, Mojave yucca (132 mg/kg), fructo-oligosaccharides, dried carrots, mannan-oligosaccharides, dried algae, stevia, propylene glycol, sugar.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 10.5%, crude fibre 16%, crude fat 6.5%, crude ash 5.5%, calcium 0.5%, phosphorus 0.3%, sodium 0.1%.
variants.feeding_instructions: Provide a limited amount as an addition and variation to the daily menu of Nature basic feed. Also provide Nature Timothy Hay for a complete feeding plan for rabbits, guinea pigs, chinchillas and degus.

variants.name: Fruities 85 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Highly varied fruit mix
  • A delicious natural mixture including pineapple, papaya, coconut, grapes and apricot
  • Very tasty composition for good intake and smooth digestion
  • Ideal snack for rabbits and herbivorous and omnivorous rodents
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: fruit (apricot 7%, pineapple 7%, papaya 7%), derivatives of vegetable origin, vegetables, seeds, vegetable protein extracts, minerals, oils and fats, FOS, calendula, MOS, algae, yucca.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin A 5450 IU, vitamin D3 654 IU, vitamin E 40 mg, iron 54 mg, iodine 1 mg, copper 5 mg, manganese 40 mg, zinc 38 mg, selenium 0.1 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: Provide a limited amount as an addition and variation to the daily menu of Nature basic feed. Also provide Nature Timothy Hay for a complete feeding plan for rabbits, guinea pigs, chinchillas and degus.
